header.known_at_rule: session_ts must be 00:00 America/New_York (Alpaca daily-bar opening boundary); known_at = 16:00 America/New_York on that date + 15 min, in UTC
header.price_basis: Alpaca adjustment=all: split- and dividend-adjusted (total-return) closes as served by Alpaca at generated_at; may reflect later corrections. Ratios of closes are PIT-correct; absolute levels before later dividends are back-adjusted (current-vintage), NOT as-traded prices. Use closes only as ratios of closes.
